Self-contained scaffold commit — site builds and runs as a complete (if early) Astro project in a single commit, no follow-on work implied by the diff.

Batch of site content/UX tweaks: added a reusable Testimonial component and placed three real client quotes (Mark, Julie, Daphne) between existing sections; added a new Approach section (psychotherapist + technologist framing, neurodiversity-friendly positioning); replaced the mailto 'Book a Session' link with a Netlify-backed contact form (honeypot + hidden form-name field) on Contact.astro and repointed Hero/HowItWorks CTAs to scroll to #contact instead of opening a mail client; expanded HowItWorks with a two-session breakdown ("Setting up the kitchen" / "Cooking the first meal") and a grid of example AI-assistant setups; linked the WhaleyBear Ltd footer credit to whaleybear.com; and added a batch of dig/curl/scutil DNS permissions to settings.local.json, consistent with troubleshooting exfu.ai domain/DNS configuration alongside the content work.
Self-contained commit — new components render and are wired into index.astro, contact form and CTA changes are complete within the diff, no follow-on work implied.

Copy and layout tweaks across the homepage plus two new standalone pages. Hero.astro: expanded the pivot line from 'Sound familiar?' to add 'I help people like you get set up with AI that actually works.' HowItWorks.astro: title-cased the heading to 'One Afternoon. Done.' and added a new subtitle 'You'll have Claude expertly set up as your personal assistant.' with matching CSS. Recognition.astro: restructured the flat 'recognition-stack' into a 'recognition-openers' + 'recognition-grid' layout (2-column grid on desktop ≥768px), added a new first-person positioning line ('ExFu isn't an app. I sit down with you and we build your AI assistant together using public AI like Claude.'), and rewrote the kicker copy to first-person framing. BaseLayout.astro: updated the default page title to 'ExFu | AI Setup, One-to-One, One Afternoon' and meta description to a more direct one-to-one pitch. Added public/exfu-embed.html, a standalone zero-dependency inline-styled HTML embed block (ExFu branding, pitch copy, CTA link to exfu.ai) for dropping into other pages or emails. Added src/pages/404.astro, a minimal meta-refresh redirect from any unmatched path back to '/'.
Self-contained commit — all copy edits, the restructured Recognition layout, the new embed widget, and the new 404 redirect page are complete within the diff, no follow-on work implied.

Regenerated the og-image.png social preview and rewrote its source copy in both og-template.html and exfu-embed.html: headline changed from 'Your AI assistant, set up in one afternoon.' to 'I set up your AI assistant with you.', and the ExFu definition text dropped the 'Like kung fu, but for getting things done.' aside in favour of 'Not an app. We build your AI assistant together. One afternoon, one-to-one.' exfu-embed.html was restructured to match og-template's definition-block layout (term/pronunciation/part-of-speech header plus definition text) in place of its previous plain headline-and-paragraph copy, with matching margin adjustments.

Built a proper favicon/icon generation pipeline and replaced the old single-SVG favicon with a full generated set. Added generate-favicons.mjs, a sharp-based CLI script that takes one source SVG and renders the full icon matrix (16/32/96/128/196 favicons, apple-touch-icons at 57 through 152px, MS tiles at 70/144/150/310x150/310x310, plus 192/512 PWA icons) and bundles a multi-size favicon.ico via the new png-to-ico devDependency; added assets/favicon/ as the source-of-truth folder holding exfu_favicon.svg, the generated PNGs/ICO, and code.txt (a realfavicongenerator-style reference snippet of the link/meta tags). attributes.text: Rename the pitch, not the plumbing. User-facing vocabulary is ExFu's Agent Library kept by Agent Librarians, ALWAYS plural: a singular Librarian character was rejected as 'pretty framing with factual misalignment' (it sets an omniscient-single-agent expectation; the truthful edifice+ecosystem frame teaches how the library needs managing). 'Substrate' is retained as the internal register, which shrinks the rename to copy surfaces (no structural renames). One exception: the boot skill becomes exfu-library because generic skill names are a cross-plugin collision risk; exfu- prefix is the convention for new/replaced skills. Dropbox replaces Box because its connector gained native delete/move (paths + revision history), making the entire Box workaround layer deletable. 'Shelf' is a teaching analogy for scope, never a rename. Migration doubles as validation: run against Al's live folders, fix the instruction rather than hand-patching.

attributes.summary: Proposal for multi-provider ExFu, born from a same-day three-agent research pass (OpenAI surface, Google surface, cross-platform standards; sources and confidence flags in the doc's appendix). Core moves: rewrite the convention base provider-agnostic with per-provider adaptors (exfu/vNEXT/providers/claude.md, openai.md) answering a fixed HOW contract (bootstrap wiring, skill install, packaging, scheduled-task registration and cadence mapping, headless runs, storage route, sandbox posture); main/augmentor model for dual-provider substrates -- main's instruction file (CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md) holds the real instructions, the augmentor's file is a plain pointer stub (store-or-point applied to instruction files; no symlinks, cloud-drive safe); scheduling defaults to main's mechanism with per-agent override to the augmentor; registry gains a provider field with a cadence-dedup rule. OpenAI is the first added provider (9 Jul 2026 ChatGPT/Codex desktop merge makes it a near-1:1 port: same SKILL.md standard, plugin+GitHub-marketplace model, global ~/.codex/AGENTS.md, sandboxed local FS, RRULE scheduled tasks); Gemini deferred to a watchlist (Antigravity CLI wrong audience, Spark Ultra/US-gated). Indicative phasing: desktop spike, core rewrite, skills portability pass + OpenAI packaging, provider-aware install flows, website/positioning. Status: proposal, awaiting Al's adoption; on adoption spawns cross-cut-provider-model, updates to T2 substrate-architecture/librarian-framework/build-and-distribution/website-changes, and a new milestone. Path: plugin/planning/proposal-multi-provider.md.

attributes.text: Operator ruling (2026-07-22, in-session): OpenAI is the first provider added beyond Claude. The core is to be rewritten completely provider-agnostic, with Claude-/OpenAI-specific adaptors instructing HOW to create things like scheduled tasks. Projects may support both providers with a declared main and augmentor: the main's instruction file carries the instructions and the augmentor's file points at it (main=claude means CLAUDE.md real + AGENTS.md pointer; main=openai the reverse). Main decides the default mechanism for creating scheduled tasks; the user and their agents may create scheduled tasks in the augmentor too. Maximum flexibility + sane defaults. Capture and commit of the proposal directed by Al; adoption into the plan tree deliberately left open.
